# Publications

Complete publications are generated from structured BibTeX and YAML metadata, then grouped by year in reverse chronological order. Citation counts are intentionally omitted because they change frequently.

Publication entries use DOI links as canonical article links where available. Code, data, preprint, and protocol links are shown only when they are part of the curated metadata.
